files <-

  for (i in 1:length(files)){

    head(n = 100) 
 if (i == 1) {  
   blast_dat <- tmp } else { 
    blast_dat <- bind_rows(blast_dat, tmp) }

```{r}
get_assembly_id <- function(subject_id = "JAKIHP010000012.1"){ 
  
  nuccore2assemblylinks <- entrez_link(dbfrom = "nuccore", db = "assembly", id = subject_id)  
 
  if (is.null(nuccore2assemblylinks$links$nuccore_assembly) ||
      length(nuccore2assemblylinks$links$nuccore_assembly) == 0) {
   
    return(NA)
    
  } else {
    
  nuccore2assemblylinks$links$nuccore_assembly %>%   
    entrez_summary(db = "assembly", id = .) %>%  
    .$assemblyaccession %>% 
    return()
  }
}

# Create an empty column
blast_dat$assembly_id = NA

# Loop through the table
for (i in 1:nrow(blast_dat)){
  blast_dat$assembly_id[i] <- get_assembly_id(subject_id = blast_dat$`subject acc.ver`[i])
}



## Those assemblies that represent MAGs are somehow different and their IDs do
## not link to an assembly. Therefore, we need to manipulate the BLAST subject
## ID to extract the "root" ID and then repeat the search on the root assembly ID
blast_dat <- blast_dat %>% 
  mutate(change = `subject acc.ver`) %>% #select(`subject acc.ver`, change) %>% 
  separate(change, into = c("id_root", "to_change"), sep = "010") %>% 
  mutate(id_root = paste0(id_root, "010")) %>% # replace the lost 010 that was removed
  separate(to_change, into = "tmp", sep = '\\.') %>% 
  mutate(replaced_suffix = str_replace_all(tmp, "[1-9]", "0")) %>% 
  mutate(root_assembly_id = paste0(id_root, replaced_suffix)) %>% 
  select(-c(id_root, tmp, replaced_suffix)) %>% 
  mutate(is_mag = case_when(
            is.na(assembly_id) ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE)
  )
 
# Loop through the table, this time with the root assembly IDs
for (i in 1:nrow(blast_dat)){
  if (is.na(blast_dat$assembly_id[i])){ 
    blast_dat$assembly_id[i] <- get_assembly_id(subject_id = blast_dat$root_assembly_id[i])
  } else {
    print ("All good!")
    }
}

  blast_dat %>% filter(is.na(assembly_id)) #%>%
  write_tsv("/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/Data/key_taxa_ww/extracted sequences of core bacteria/assembly_information/blast2assembly.tsv")

blast2assembly %>% select(assembly_id, system, taxonomic_level, taxa) %>% distinct()
blast2assembly %>% group_by(taxa) %>% slice_max(order_by = `% identity` , n = 10)

blast2assembly %>% select(assembly_id, taxa, `% identity`)

## Identify some edge cases and solve them
blast_dat <- blast_dat %>% filter(is.na(assembly_id)) %>%
  mutate(root_assembly_id = str_remove(`subject acc.ver`, "\\.1$")) %>% # Remove .1 suffix
  mutate(root_assembly_id = str_sub(root_assembly_id, 1, nchar(root_assembly_id)-4)) %>% # Keep all but last 4 digits
  mutate(root_assembly_id = paste0(root_assembly_id, "0000")) %>% # Append four zeros
  bind_rows(blast_dat %>% filter(!is.na(assembly_id)), .)

## Rerun the extraction of assembly IDs
for (i in 1:nrow(blast_dat)){
  if (is.na(blast_dat$assembly_id[i])){ 
    blast_dat$assembly_id[i] <- get_assembly_id(subject_id = blast_dat$root_assembly_id[i])
  } else {
    print ("All good!")
    }
}
```

```{r summarise_assemblies, caption = "No. of representative genomes per taxa"}
blast_dat %>% filter(!is.na(assembly_id)) %>% 
  filter(`% identity` >= 95) %>% 
  select(assembly_id, system, taxonomic_level, taxa) %>% distinct() %>% 
  group_by(taxonomic_level, taxa) %>% summarise(no_of_assemblies = n()) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```
